status: PREREGISTERED before any Study B final evaluation; frozen in configs/v5/slip/FREEZE.json and tag experiment-v5b. Deviations are recorded in docs/v5/DECISIONS.md and labelled in the report.
study: V5 Study B - dynamic in-grasp slip after the calibration window
research_question: When the bar slides in the giver's grip after the 0.5 s calibration window has closed and before the receiver grasps, does a learned residual with observation history recover better than the same residual without history and than the strongest training-free controller?
condition_note: V5_EXECUTION.md lists slip_neg_5; -5 mm is infeasible (probe), so it is slip_neg_2 (-2 mm). Slip draws are clamped so start x + slip x stays in the feasible cumulative range.
outcome: success = terminal_reason == 'success'; every scheduled case is in the denominator; invalid resets and invalid slips (realized slip outside 1.5 mm of target in x/z) are failures for every method.

learned.parent: geometry_calibrated (V4 one-shot 0.5 s calibration, EMA 0.2, bound 25 mm)

selection.rule: validation suite (clean, static_mixed_id, slip_pos_10, slip_mixed_id; 40 cases each); key: 1. mean success with equal weight per condition (all scheduled cases; invalid resets/slips count as failures), desc; 2. unsafe-event rate (any prohibited collision or drop), asc; 3. residual magnitude (mean per-episode mean max-axis |residual|), asc; 4. later candidate (larger transition count). Values rounded to 12 decimals. Step 0 is an untrained control and never eligible. Final outcomes are never read.
selection.reported: selected and final (10,027,008 transitions) checkpoints separately

primary.interval: paired hierarchical bootstrap over training seeds and base cases (deterministic controllers broadcast over seeds), 10,000 draws, seed 6458401; implementation scripts/final_review_audit.py::paired_bootstrap; 95% and Bonferroni 97.5% percentile intervals
primary.decision: superiority only if the 97.5% lower bound > 0; no equivalence claims

secondary_exploratory: every method x every condition (selected and final checkpoints)
slip_robust_repeat - slip_robust_ff (temporal order vs input size), every condition
geometry_tracking - geometry_calibrated (does continuous re-estimation fix stale calibration), every condition
final vs selected checkpoints per learned profile
regression: selected Study B policies on static_mixed_id and on the V4 final suite (configs/v4/suites/final.jsonl with zero slip) against the published V4 selected policies of the same architecture
failure taxonomy incl. invalid_slip, receiver contact before grasp, misalignment at grasp

interventions: development-fitted constant (mean residual of the selected history policy on the development suite) on the parent

repeatability.entries: all executed training-free baselines and the selected seed-111 checkpoint of each learned profile, full final suite
repeatability.metric: terminal-outcome agreement with the primary process
